+    // A real trailing // comment must still be ignored

commits.subject: ui: pdf - GeneratePdf15File documented for PDF/A-1
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: ui: pdf - PDF/A-1 gets an xref table, whatever version its features ask for
commits.body:
PDF/A-1 forbids a cross-reference stream (ISO 19005-1 6.1.4, veraPDF rule
6.1.4-3), and with it object streams, but SaveToStreamDirectEnd wrote them
for any header of 1.5 or more: GeneratePdf15File, vpEnforcePrintScaling or
optional content under PDF/A-1. Under PDF/A-1 the file now ends with a
classic xref table; the header stays as asked, which veraPDF accepts.

PdfA1XrefTable: 2 of its 4 checks fail before the change.
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: net: fixed THttpProxyServer local folder URI with a query string
commits.body:
The route parameter stops at the ? but UrlDecodeVar() decodes up to the
ending #0, so the query string became part of the file name, and e.g.
/static/hello.txt?v=2 returned 404.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: fixed THttpProxyServer 304 on a remote resource with only an ETag
commits.body:
THttpProxyUrl.ReturnFile took a remote resource with no Last-Modified
for a local folder file, so the client If-None-Match was never compared
to the ETag of the origin, and the whole content was always returned.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: fixed THttpProxyServer remote Source with no trailing /
commits.body:
A Source like 'http://ftp.debian.org/debian', as documented in
THttpProxyUrlSettings, was concatenated with the requested path with no
separator, so the origin was asked for e.g. /debianpool/... and returned 404.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: new mormot.net.proxy unit extracted from mormot.net.async - see #392
commits.body:
Pure move of the THttpProxyServer section and of the initialization block,
with only two changes needed across the new unit boundary:
- THttpProxyServer.Start calls the existing public SetProgressiveRequests()
  method, as mormot.net.peercache does
- THttpAsyncServer.IdleEverySecond is now public
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: core: TExternalProcess roWinJobCloseChildren also closes the children on POSIX
commits.body:
On Windows, this option kills any child still running when the instance is
released. On POSIX, once the process itself had ended, nothing stopped the
children it left: its pid, so its process group number, could be reused.

With this option on Linux, FreeBSD and MacOS, the ended process is now
detected with waitid(WNOWAIT) and kept as a zombie, so that DoClose can
kill its process group, then reap it. RunRedirect() still ignores the
option on POSIX.

Tested with FPC 3.2.3 on Linux x86_64, aarch64 and arm (qemu-user), on
FreeBSD 14.5 amd64, and with Delphi 13.0 for Linux64.
